sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Administration module is accessible only to Controllers. It is organized into a five-section sidebar — Master Data, Reference Catalogues, Planning & Ranking, Portfolio Hierarchy, and System — covering 24 admin sub-surfaces in total. All changes are logged in the categorised audit trail.

sections.title: 5-Section Sidebar Navigation (v5)
sections.body: Section 1 · Master Data: Cost Centers, Competence Centers, Lines of Business, Workforce Locations, People, plus Cluster F's Charging Locations, Legal Entities, Regions, Countries, and User Measurement. Section 2 · Reference Catalogues: Role Types, External Cost Types, Project Dependencies. Section 3 · Planning & Ranking: Planning Parameters. Section 4 · Portfolio Hierarchy. Section 5 · System: Users, Role Permissions, Rate Tables, Workflow Templates, Scheduled Changes, Audit Log.

sections.title: Cluster F Master Data (Charging Locations, Legal Entities, Regions, Countries)
sections.body: Charging Locations are Knorr-Bremse charging codes (~90 codes, e.g. DE-MUC-001) used for inter-service distribution and SAP cost flows; each carries division, region, and country attributes. Legal Entities (~120 registered companies) roll up many-to-one to a Charging Location and have their own Country attribute for divergence cases. Regions and Countries are simple lookup catalogues. Hover the info icon on each panel header for a definition tooltip per [F-MD-01].

sections.title: User Measurement Matrix
sections.body: Sparse year × quarter × S-code × charging-location matrix with row and column totals. Use the period selector (year + quarter) and version selector (Latest import / specific imports) to view a snapshot. CSV upload creates a new version (no overwrite — versioning by import timestamp). The Automatic refresh button is intentionally stubbed in the demo: it returns 'not connected to a UM source' as an explanatory dialog rather than a network error, preserving the integration boundary for production SAP-API connection.

sections.title: Workflow Templates
sections.body: Six configurable workflows ship: Forecast Cycle (5 steps), Intake / Pipeline Progression (5), Change Request (4), Send Back (3), Milestone Baseline Override (3), Scheduled Master Data Activation (3). Step sequence is fixed (admin cannot reorder); per-step touchpoints are editable: required / skippable, assigned role, data gates (comma-separated completeness criteria), notifications (JSON object — trigger ➜ recipients, e.g. {"on_start": ["all_pls"]}), time-constraint days, and escalation action. Templates ship as configurable data only in v5; live workflow execution wiring is a follow-on session.

sections.title: Scheduled Changes
sections.body: Future-dated master-data and parameter changes pending review or activation. Lifecycle: pending_review → approved → activated (or rejected / cancelled). Per-row actions: Approve, Reject, Cancel. The 'Apply due changes' button manually triggers the activation engine which processes approved changes whose date has passed; in v5 only planning_parameter activation is wired through to the live entity (other entity types record the activation as a no-op for the demo).

sections.title: Audit Log V2
sections.body: Categorised audit entries across all admin actions. Eight categories: master_data, configuration, hierarchy, forecast_actions, pipeline_transitions, simulator, access_control, scheduled_change_lifecycle. Filter by category, entity type, and date range. Each entry shows the timestamp, user, entity, action, and an old → new diff column. Export the filtered set to CSV or Excel via the buttons in the panel header.

sections.title: Role Permissions Grid
sections.body: Per-role × per-entity-type permission grants for BTC Profile and Stage 1 Distribution edits, plus generic master-data overrides. Default behaviour: the responsible person owns the entity; the Controller has audit-trailed override authority. Add additional grants here; changes affect BTC profile + distribution edit gates immediately on save and are recorded in the audit log under category access_control.

sections.title: Tech Navigator Weights
sections.body: Tech Navigator scoring is configurable via Planning Parameters in the tech_navigator group. Sub-criterion weights default to Complexity 40/40/20 (Standardization / Usage / Maintenance) and Value Creation 50/40/10 (Financial benefit / Payback / Competitive advantage). Composite ranking weights default to Value 70 % · Complexity 30 %. T-shirt size thresholds (XS ≤ 100k €, S ≤ 250k €, M ≤ 500k €, L ≤ 1M €, XL above) are also editable. Editing any tn_* parameter triggers a portfolio-wide score recompute.

sections.title: Entity Type Selector
sections.body: The left panel organizes manageable items into three categories. **Entities** includes: Cost Centers, Competence Centers, Lines of Business, Locations, People, and Rate Tables. **Portfolio Structure** provides access to the Portfolio Hierarchy configuration panel. **System** contains Planning Parameters and the Audit Log. Select any item to see its management view on the right.

sections.title: CRUD Operations
sections.body: For each entity type, you can create new entries, edit existing ones, and deactivate records. **Important:** {app_name} uses deactivation instead of deletion — deactivated records are hidden from active views but preserved for historical accuracy. Deactivation may cascade (e.g., deactivating a cost center affects its people).

sections.title: Cost Center Management
sections.body: Create cost centers with a name, location, and competence center assignment. Edit to change assignments. Deactivate to remove from active views while preserving allocation history.

sections.title: People Management
sections.body: Add people with name, role type, and cost center assignment. Edit to transfer between cost centers or change roles. Deactivate when someone leaves. The system preserves all historical allocations and cost calculations.

sections.title: Rate Table Management
sections.body: View and update hourly rates per role per competence center. When updating a rate, set the new effective date. The system preserves the previous rate and effective date for audit purposes. Historical cost calculations always use the rate that was in effect at the time.

sections.title: Portfolio Hierarchy Management
sections.body:
The Portfolio Hierarchy panel (under Portfolio Structure) lets you configure how projects are grouped across the application. It has four sub-tabs:

**Entity Types** — Define grouping categories such as Line of Business, Programme, or Division. Each type has a name and optional description.

**Hierarchies** — Arrange entity types into ordered levels to form a tree structure. One hierarchy can be marked as **Active** — this determines the grouping used across all modules. Only one hierarchy can be active at a time.

**Grouping Entities** — Create and manage the actual entities within each type (e.g., 'Truck & Bus Systems' under Line of Business, 'Rail Signalling' under Programme). Set parent-child relationships between entities of different types.

**Hierarchy Assignment** — View the active hierarchy as a tree and see which projects are assigned to which entities. Drag or reassign projects between entities.

The active hierarchy's labels propagate across **Portfolio Overview** (tree grouping and filters), **Capacity Management** (pivot dimensions), **Project Workbench** (entity selector fields), and **Reporting** (filter and dimension labels).

sections.title: Planning Parameters
sections.body:
Configure system-wide settings organized into six groups:

**Fiscal Settings** — Fiscal Year Start Month.
**Planning Horizon** — Number of planning years ahead.
**Thresholds** — RAG thresholds (Amber and Red percentages for variance-based status calculations).
**Limits** — Maximum Scenarios per User and other system caps.
**Capacity Settings** — Target Utilization percentage for capacity planning.
**Integrations** — API key management for external services. The Anthropic API key (used by the AI Report Builder) is stored here as a secret parameter with masked display. Use the **eye icon** to temporarily reveal the key value. Each group has its own **Save** and **Reset to Defaults** controls.

sections.title: Audit Trail
sections.body: All administrative changes are logged with timestamp, who made the change, what entity was affected, the specific field changed, and old/new values. The audit log is visible at the bottom of the Administration module.
